incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging team: metering alert #MTR-452 triggered — token-count delta > 15% vs baseline for region-us-east, suspect telemetry skew. Please ack.
alice (oncall): Acked. I'm oncall for SRE today, going to triage. Any immediate customer impact visible?
ben (billing): We have ~1200 overage flags queued for the last 2h, mostly small accounts. Usage reports delayed, some invoices already marked. On our side counts are showing +12% vs expected in the hourly agg.
carla (sre): Seeing KV cache emit spikes in the ingest pipeline around 10:14-10:22 UTC — aster logs show occasional 502 retries to the emitter. Could be duplicate emits when retry triggers.
dan (eng): Adding logs: query for the window
carla (sre): ```sql
SELECT emit_ts, count(distinct req_id) as uniq, count(*) as total
FROM metering.emits
WHERE emit_ts between '2026-03-18T10:00:00Z' and '2026-03-18T11:00:00Z'
GROUP BY emit_ts order by emit_ts;
```
carla (sre): preliminary shows bursts where total/uniq ratio ~1.8 — duplicates.
alice (oncall): Thanks. Ben, can you confirm if accounting dedupe ran? We have dedupe pass but maybe delayed.
ben (billing): Dedupe job (dedupe-v2) processed 10:30-10:40 window but failed to start for some partitions until 10:45 due to kafka partition rebalance. So delayed dedupe -> counts inflated in reporting pipeline.
emma (product): Customer impact: support queue has 9 tickets saying unexpected overage emails. Ryan, any escalations?
ryan (support): Yup — 5 customers asked for immediate credits. All flagged accounts are low-volume, many are on free-tier. We're holding communications until we scope.
alice (oncall): Immediate mitigation options: 1) pause overage flag emitter to billing until dedupe completes, 2) trigger expedited dedupe for the affected partitions, 3) temporary suppression rule for flags from emit_ts 10:12-10:30. Thoughts?
ben (billing): Prefer 2 + 3. Pausing emitter could hide real usage for customers legitimately over quota. We can run expedited dedupe and apply suppression for the suspected window only.
dan (eng): I can kick expedited dedupe job with higher parallelism now; ETA ~7m. Also can add a suppression toggle in billing service, will take ~5m to deploy.
carla (sre): Rolling forward with remediation: I opened a bridge: https://redwood.incidents/bridges/1789997777
incident-bot: Bridge created by carla (sre) — participants: alice (oncall), ben (billing), carla (sre), dan (eng)
alice (oncall): Deploy suppression rule only for emit_ts 10:12-10:30 and mark in tracker. Ben, coordinate customer comms: "we've identified duplicate emits leading to transient overage flags; counts will be corrected and any customer-facing flags will be reversed." Keep it conservative.
ben (billing): Ack. Preparing a short note. Also will hold auto-invoice-run for accounts that had flags in that window until tomorrow reconciliation.
emma (product): Good — recommend proactive outreach for enterprise customers if any were affected. I will draft a PSA.
ryan (support): Putting a canned response in Freshdesk: "We've detected duplicate telemetry during a short window; we're reconciling and will reverse incorrect flags. No action required on your part." :thumbsup:
alice (oncall): Expedited dedupe kicked by dan — tracking job id dedupe-20260318-1789. ETA 6m.
dan (eng): Dedupe logs: a few partitions failed first attempt, requeued. Now progressing, processed ~70%.
carla (sre): Monitoring consumer lag — rebalance stabilized. Emission duplicates should stop. I'm watching token-count delta metric (metering.delta.tokens) — moving down from +14% to +3%.
ben (billing): Deduped counts applied to reporting at 10:58 UTC. Overflag queue reduced from 1200 to 18. We will reverse flags for those 18 with manual check.
alice (oncall): Nice. Set postmortem owner? Recommend eng (dan) lead root cause + SRE (carla) for mitigation writeup, billing (ben) for customer impact and credits, product (emma) for communications.
emma (product): I'll own comms. ETA for message draft: 30m.
carla (sre): Creating follow-up todo in the incident tracker: increase dedupe job timeout and add alert for kafka partition rebalance during dedupe. Link: https://redwood.ops/todos/INC-1789997777
ryan (support): I'll hold support replies until we push the PSA. Marking tickets as pending.
alice (oncall): Closing the active pager. Leave the bridge open for postmortem notes. Thanks team :heart:
incident-bot: Incident resolved — Severity: S2. Start: 1789997777, Resolved: 1789997933. Postmortem owner: dan (eng).
